name: grist-data-logs
description: Operate self-hosted Grist as a retry-safe application event log and private analysis store.

interface.shortDescription: Run Grist as a safe application event log.
interface.longDescription: Plan and operate a self-hosted Grist event-log table with retry-safe REST writes, delivery receipts, post-write verification, read-only SQL analysis, and a Full-edition MCP connection path.
defaultPrompt: Set up a replay-safe Grist AppEvents log for this application.
Plan a non-destructive Grist schema change for my event table.
Analyze this Grist event log without modifying its data.
Explain whether my self-hosted Grist can use MCP safely.
